title: A request typed while Ask is working waits its turn, and can be cancelled before it starts
goal: When a person sends a second request while Ask is still on the first, Ask keeps it in line and runs it next, instead of doing nothing with it. Each waiting request shows as a row in the Agent area with a way to cancel it before it starts, and the one that is running can be stopped too.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-20: 'if I type a message while its working, it doesn't queue the message. It should queue and let me cancel in the agent ux if it hasn't started.'

Seen in code, not run: AskSession.ask (Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskSession.swift:85) opens with guard !words.isEmpty, !isBusy else { return }, so a send while busy is silently ignored; the words stay in the field. The change rows from ask-makes-the-change-straight-away-and-each-chan (AskChanges.swift) are where waiting rows belong. work is a Task, so stop can cancel it; check what a cancel mid-run leaves in the document and in History. Also the send button and Return are disabled while busy (AskViews.swift:96 and :225), which is why nothing appears to happen.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults: send a request, and while it is planning send another; record what happens to the second (the before)
A request sent while Ask is busy is kept: it shows at once as a waiting row in the Agent area with its words and a cancel control, and runs as soon as the one before it finishes, in the order sent
Cancelling a waiting row removes it and nothing of it ever runs; the running request has a stop that ends it and leaves the document as it was before that request (one row, nothing half applied)
Each request still becomes its own change row when done (switch and delete), and one Command Z still takes back the latest finished request whole
A request that waits plans against the document as the one before it left it, not as it was when typed
Waiting requests belong to their document: closing the document drops them, and asking in another window has its own line

Walks for queue, cancel waiting, and stop running, with pictures in an audit under queue/audits/. Copy short and plain, no em dashes. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: owns these walks: ask-queues-a-request-walk, ask-cancels-a-waiting-request-walk, ask-stops-a-running-request-walk

Reproduced at Next defaults (before): sent 'add a blue rectangle', then while planning sent 'add a red circle' via the composer; the second stayed in the field with Ask greyed out and never ran (one change row only). Picture: queue/audits/2026-10-21-ask-queue-0-before.png

Adversarial review: no mock covers a queue. A Premiere/Photoshop user has no direct analogue; chat tools (and Claude Code) queue a message typed while busy, which is what the user asked for. Risk found: Stop sets phase idle before the work Task ends, so isBusy now tracks the Task (current), not the phase, so a send in that gap waits instead of running two at once. Also found: a stop while Ask looked at its own drawing kept the drawing; now it is taken back.

Chose waiting rows above the working row, newest first, over next-to-run at top, because the change rows are newest first and this way a request moves down the list without any row jumping. Chose Stop ends only the request at work (the next waiting one then starts) over clearing the line, because each waiting row already has its own cancel. Chose the working row shows its request's words over 'Working…', so it is clear which request Stop ends.

left rough: closing a window drops its line and stops the request at work (EditorView.onDisappear -> AskSession.windowClosed), verified by reading only since no walk step closes a window; stop during step landing not caught by a walk (landing takes ms). Neither clears the follow-up bar: no one would notice a difference today.

A request sent while Ask works waits as a row above the working one (clock, words, X to cancel) and runs next on the document the one before left; Stop ends only the request at work. Core AskRequestLine (PhotonzCore, tested), AskSession/AskViews, close hook in EditorView, walk condition askSettled.
